sheets.prompt: Create one PRODUCTION transparent animation sprite sheet from attached approved original character concept. Preserve character identity, outfit colors, mask/face, cloak and ONE long two-handed REAPER SCYTHE. Convert concept into detailed hand-painted PIXEL-LIKE 2.5D RPG sprite art with crisp contour, not realistic photography. EXACTLY FOUR columns x THREE rows, TWELVE separate complete full-body poses. Row1: four WALK cycle poses with clearly alternating LEFT foot forward / passing / RIGHT foot forward / passing, feet really move and cloak sways. Row2: four ATTACK phases: scythe windup, wide crescent slash, compact hit follow-through, recovery. Row3 col1 CAST charge, col2 CAST release, col3 HIT recoil, col4 HIT recover. ONE staff-length shaft with ONE crescent blade must stay held in BOTH hands in EVERY frame, including cast and hit. Two arms/two legs only. Magic originates at blade while gripping weapon. Same head/body proportions, fixed elevated game camera and scale, consistent feet baseline. Fit entire character AND scythe blade AND shaft ends AND cloak/wings/effects within CENTRAL 60% of each cell; VERY LARGE fully TRANSPARENT gutters on all sides including outer border. No touching adjacent figures, no edge cuts. Scythe may angle to fit cell but NEVER shorten into a hand sickle. No floor, ground circle, shadow, scenery, text, numbers, labels or grid. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard. Compact thin magical slash effects only, never hide silhouette.  CHARACTER: Adult female vampire reaper, pale face, long silver hair, black and antique-gold plate armor, burgundy split battle coat and cape, red gemstone accents, armored boots. Giant long black-shaft scythe with ONE crimson crescent blade and a red gem socket. Mature fierce face and elegant athletic silhouette; no sexualization. DIRECTION: ALL12 face SOUTH toward viewer: front face/mask and chest visible. Keep front-facing orientation even during attack/cast/recoil.
